# 0.1.2 — setup, lint, migrate, live skills, and generate on empty repos

11 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.1** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.2
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Added

- `opentide setup ci` writes `OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT` into generated GitHub, GitLab, and Azure pipelines ([#51](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/51)).
- `opentide setup env` writes `.env.example` and ignores `.env` ([#48](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/48)).
- `opentide setup hooks` installs a validate-on-commit pre-commit hook ([#49](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/49)).
- `opentide lint` checks filename slugs and recommended metadata (`--fix`, `--strict`) ([#108](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/108)).
- `opentide migrate objects` moves CoreTide `Configurations/` and `Objects/` into the greenfield layout ([#100](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/100)).

## Changed

- `opentide setup skills` fetches the live [OpenTideHQ/skills](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/skills) catalogue. The wheel no longer ships a stale snapshot. If GitHub is unreachable, the command fails instead of installing outdated copies ([#152](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/152)).

## Fixed

- `opentide generate` completes on a freshly scaffolded empty repository. Missing snippet templates are skipped; an empty catalogue is a valid export ([#153](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/153)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup skills discover
opentide generate
opentide lint --strict
```

Expect `0.1.2`. `discover` lists the live catalogue (requires GitHub). `generate` on a new `setup repo` scaffold must exit 0.
